channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2019-11708 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a sandbox escape vulnerability that could result in remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-7193 — QNAP QTS
item.description: Threat Signal 73. QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

item.title: CVE-2012-1710 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Unspecified vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Forms Recognition component in Oracle Fusion Middleware allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to Designer.

item.title: CVE-2016-2386 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 74. SQL injection vulnerability in the UDDI server in SAP NetWeaver J2EE Engine 7.40 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via unspecified vectors.

item.title: CVE-2018-19949 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

item.title: CVE-2018-7841 — Schneider Electric U.motion Builder
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A SQL Injection vulnerability exists in U.motion Builder software which could cause unwanted code execution when an improper set of characters is entered.

item.title: CVE-2014-0780 — InduSoft Web Studio
item.description: Threat Signal 75. InduSoft Web Studio NTWebServer contains a directory traversal vulnerability that allows remote attackers to read administrative passwords in APP files, allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2017-8543 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows allows an attacker to take control of the affected system when Windows Search fails to handle objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2019-1003029 — Jenkins Script Security Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Jenkins Script Security Plugin contains a protection mechanism failure, allowing an attacker to bypass the sandbox.

item.title: CVE-2018-6065 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2014-4148 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel-mode driver improperly handles TrueType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2016-7256 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows font library improperly handles specially crafted embedded fonts. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2016-4657 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Apple iOS WebKit contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted web site. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2017-6862 — NETGEAR Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2015-4495 — Mozilla Firefox
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Moxilla Firefox allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy to read arbitrary files or gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-8651 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Integer overflow in Adobe Flash Player allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2019-3568 — Meta Platforms WhatsApp
item.description: Threat Signal 68. A buffer overflow vulnerability in WhatsApp VOIP stack allowed remote code execution via specially crafted series of RTCP packets sent to a target phone number.

item.title: CVE-2019-13720 — Google Chrome WebAudio
item.description: Threat Signal 73. Google Chrome WebAudio contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page.

item.title: CVE-2011-2462 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 77. The Universal 3D (U3D) component in Adobe Reader and Acrobat contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2010-5330 — Ubiquiti AirOS
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Certain Ubiquiti devices contain a command injection vulnerability via a GET request to stainfo.cgi.

item.title: CVE-2016-0984 — Adobe Flash Player and AIR
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player and Adobe AIR allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2016-1646 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service or possibly have another unspecified impact via crafted JavaScript code. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2006-2492 — Microsoft Word
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Word and Microsoft Works Suites contain a malformed object pointer which allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2019-18426 — Meta Platforms WhatsApp
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A vulnerability in WhatsApp Desktop when paired with WhatsApp for iPhone allows cross-site scripting and local file reading.

item.title: CVE-2016-3393 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists due to the way the Windows GDI component handles objects in the memory. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2015-2425 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2014-4123 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 67. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to gain privileges via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2015-0016 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Directory traversal vulnerability in the TS WebProxy (TSWbPrxy) component in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to escalate privileges.

item.title: CVE-2010-1297 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Adobe Flash Player contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2009-4324 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Acrobat and Reader allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted PDF file.

item.title: CVE-2011-0609 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2010-2572 — Microsoft PowerPoint
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft PowerPoint contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that alllows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2009-0563 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a Word document with a crafted tag containing an invalid length field.

item.title: CVE-2013-1331 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Office contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via crafted PNG data in an Office document.

item.title: CVE-2012-4969 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2008-0655 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an unespecified vulnerability described as a design flaw which could allow a specially crafted file to be printed silently an arbitrary number of times.

item.title: CVE-2019-11707 — Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird
item.description: Threat Signal 66. Mozilla Firefox and Thunderbird contain a type confusion vulnerability that can occur when manipulating JavaScript objects due to issues in Array.pop, allowing for an exploitable crash.

item.title: CVE-2009-3953 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe Acrobat and Reader contains an array boundary issue in Universal 3D (U3D) support that could lead to remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2018-17463 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2012-1889 — Microsoft XML Core Services
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft XML Core Services contains a memory corruption vulnerability which could allow for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2014-0322 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2014-0546 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 64. Adobe Reader and Acrobat on Windows allow attackers to bypass a sandbox protection mechanism, and consequently execute native code in a privileged context.

item.title: CVE-2009-0557 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Microsoft Office contains an object record corruption vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code via a crafted Excel file with a malformed record object.

item.title: CVE-2021-38163 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 65. SAP NetWeaver contains a vulnerability that allows unrestricted file upload.

item.title: CVE-2018-4990 — Adobe Acrobat and Reader
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Adobe Acrobat and Reader have a double free vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute code inside a sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2016-5198 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to perform read/write operations, leading to code execution, via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2015-1671 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when components of Windows, .NET Framework, Office, Lync, and Silverlight fail to properly handle TrueType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2019-1385 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 67. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists when the Windows AppX Deployment Extensions improperly performs privilege management, resulting in access to system files.
